reason: My backlog of small content and translation jobs goes to ChatGPT or Claude first, and I only pay a person when the draft isn't good enough. A contest where most entrants get nothing still feels like spec work to me, and I don't want to run that on my community's name.
objection: Everyone who doesn't win works for free, and that feels like spec work. I'd also be paying in USDC on Solana through an unaudited product from a solo founder, and I already get the draft from AI for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If AI drafts clearly failed on a specific job, such as niche-language translation with native-level checking, and the free first task showed a winning entry beating my AI draft. Entrants being paid something just for entering would help too.
